scope: Native single-NIC KVM node-group scaling through KEDA Redis external metrics and the group scale subresource. Five permanent site VMs and up to three cloud VMs across two cloud networks.

method.demand: Controlled Redis list; three items per Machine; maximum three Machines. Queue operations trigger capacity changes.
method.placement: KEDA and Redis on permanent site worker w2; one separate scheduling probe retained during the cycle.
method.images: Images preloaded through QEMU Guest Agent; fresh workers receive the campaign dialer and busybox probe images before Ready and network validation.
method.observation: API state sampled every two seconds; VM stop and slot release checked separately.

limitations: Controlled queue depth does not qualify job consumption or workload autoscaling.
Network matrices run after convergence; these results do not measure packet loss during scaling.
Windows, GPU, CAPA, Prometheus, and cloud cold-start image behavior need separate qualification.
